text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health operating budget variance for the three months ended on March 31, 2018. The Toronto Public Health 2018 Operating Budget was underspent by $32.5 thousand net or 0.3 percent for the three months ended on March 31, 2018.
The Board of Health received the report (June 4, 2018) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
